items.title: Germany's Ruhr Valley is on brink of financial collapse
items.description: With tax revenues down and social spending up, more and more cities and towns in the Ruhrgebiet are struggling to make ends meet. One city that is particularly deep in the red is Oberhausen.

items.title: Former Emir of Qatar Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani dies aged 74
items.description: He took power in 1996 after staging a bloodless coup against his father, and went on to transform Qatar into the gas-rich power it is today.

items.title: Spain wildfire: Firefighters begin to contain deadly blaze
items.description: Firefighters have started to rein in the wildfire that killed 12 people in the southern Andalusia region, which is home to one of Spain's largest expat communities.

items.title: US senator and close Trump ally Lindsey Graham dies after 'brief and sudden illness'
items.description: Donald Trump pays tribute to the 71-year-old South Carolina senator, calling him a "true American patriot" who will be "greatly missed".

items.title: Badly burned British couple rescued from ravine during Spain wildfires, reports say
items.description: The unnamed pair were found semi-conscious with 40% burns after being trapped by the blazes raging through Almeria province, local media reports.

items.title: David Willey, esteemed BBC Vatican correspondent, dies aged 93
items.description: One of the BBC's longest-serving foreign correspondents, he reported on five popes during his career.
